title: scale-fill-viridis-d
subtitle: Discrete viridis fill scale.
category: Scales
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


`option` selects between `"viridis"`, `"magma"`, `"plasma"`, `"inferno"`,
and `"cividis"`.

## Usage

```typst
scale-fill-viridis-d(
  option: "viridis",
  name: none,
  limits: none,
  labels: auto,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `option` | `"viridis"` | Palette name: `"viridis"`, `"magma"`, `"plasma"`, `"inferno"`, or `"cividis"`. |
| `name` | `none` | Legend title. Overrides any name set via [`labs`](../labs/labs.qmd) when both are present. |
| `limits` | `none` | Array of level names controlling order and inclusion, or `none`. |
| `labels` | `auto` | Array of legend labels aligned with `limits`, or `auto`. |

## Returns

Scale object consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/scale-fill-viridis-d-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (grp: "a", y: 1),
  (grp: "b", y: 2),
  (grp: "c", y: 3),
  (grp: "d", y: 4),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "grp", y: "y", fill: "grp"),
  layers: (geom-col(),),
  scales: (scale-fill-viridis-d(option: "cividis"),),
)
```
